sample_unit: de-identified discharge records of patients with diabetes (each yielding LLM-generated education materials)

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-generated discharge education materials rated by nursing experts
links.effect: Accuracy scores for all three models were ≥98%, with no significant differences (P > .01).
links.quote: Accuracy scores for all models were ≥98%, and there were no significant differences in accuracy (P > .01).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance, accuracy, and safety of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Doubao 1.5, DeepSeek R1) in generating patient discharge education materials from de-identified clinical records, evaluated by nursing experts without testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard comparison.
